title: Solar Battery Sungrow 25kWh Battery+5kWh $5500 +Free EV Charge (worth $3500) + upgrade options @ Dodo Solar
body:
Deal: Solar Battery Sungrow 25kWh Battery+5kWh $5500 +Free EV Charge (worth $3500) + upgrade options @ Dodo Solar

[A 1] If you're associated, please tick the box to indicate that to everyone ;-)
Edit: Cheers.
[Wiser] What will be the price for 40 kwh
15 kwh 3 phase inverter with DC coupling in VIC?
[dodosolar] Hi We need to review the site photos, please fill up the form for a complete quote.
[Wiser] Can you give base price?
So that we both are not wasting time
[dodosolar] We have options from $7900 , please send some site photos to review.
[DebitATO] Anything similar in SA with included 6.6khw panels installed?
[dodosolar] Yes it's available for SA area, but without the EV charger.
other area will get the deal without EV charger with more discount.
please fill up the form for a complete quote.
[dodosolar] Yes it's available for QLD area, but without the EV charger.
other area will get the deal without EV charger with more discount.
please fill up the form for a complete quote.
[sexy] NSW area customers with concession card holders/health card holders/family income less than $80,000 are also eligible for a FREE SUNGROW EV Charger (Model: AC22E-01)
So this ev charger thingy is not for everyone?
[dodosolar] EV charge is for NSW only. other area will get the deal without EV charger with more discount.
[thanq] Do you have your own installers in nsw or do you sub contract it out?
[noz] What deposit needs to be paid, and when does the remainder need to be paid?
[dodosolar] $1000 deposit to start, balance on complete of installation.
[Mike444] Finally, some actually reasonable payment terms.
[bcarp] Is this your price, or dependent on government rebates?
[bcarp] Ah, is this the rebate that can only be applied once per property? Because that’s kinda important to put in your description. We have a battery under the rebate but want to expand. No more rebates are allowable. And the rebate also requires solar panels?
[dodosolar] Yes they are standard 'cheaper home batteries program' offers. would require solar panels.
and if you already have battery wouldn't be able to get this price as rebate can only be applied once.
[Pantone] Maybe a silly question, but do you sell just the saying 25 kilowatt batteries that I could recharge from my household PowerPoint, but have as a backup that I could plug into if there was a power outage, or does it have to be connected to a whole solar system, etc?
[dodosolar] This one needs to connect to the meterbox, you can have back up system add in so the house will still have power during grid power outage.
[Tofu Titan] Any sweetener for the OzBargain community?
[tof] Is the work done by subcontractors?
Thanks.
[Yorkshire-Man] In every location? I'm call b/s… particularly using a jotform
[Bruceflix] $3500 for an ev charger? What a crock! Is it made of gold?
[Bruceflix] Tell me how it is "worth 3500!"
Obviously you just made that price up to sound like a good deal.
[willyroo] Paid just under $900 for the 3 phase Sungrow AC22E EV charger.
Complete overkill for a single phase system.
[Skitzout] $5749 for sungrow 10kw inverter and 30kw Batt. QLD. www.solarbattery.com.au
[dodosolar] we can help with price match. please fill up the form for a complete quote.
[Skitzout] You said this was a good deal but there is much better for only $249 more
www.solarbattery.au corrected now. Same series inverter and same series battery. Apparently soon they are going to a 8 or 10kw module battery system.
[Rogue01] Sounds great, but the link doesn't work. I assume you mean just .au . Anyway, had a quick look and couldn't see it there. Would love to be proven wrong though!
[Skitzout] Get a hold of shark solar. As they also do same same deal
[Rogue01] Have you dealt with them before? They look like another potential sub contractor organiser….?
[Skitzout] @Rogue01: Not the entire process. Im just holding to see how the whole industry goes. Not sure how the drop in rebates will affect it in a good or bad way. I relate to solar. Had all this rebate but right now its cheap as chips
[Rogue01] @Skitzout: I want to be off grid sustainable before we lose the chance 😆 it wasn't economical to get batteries when I got the panels but yeah, you're right, it's cheap now. But how long?
[shaidas] They are the same mob..I had a sofar 25 kW installed from solarbattery but dodo solar billed me..when asked solarbattery told me they are tied up with dodo solar for local rebates in WA …And I looked it up and it needs an office address which btw is a shared address :-D so it is all a very dodgy set up but they do have people on payroll and I have had a great install. The price is great..but I doubt there will be any long term support
[Wiadro] 5kW Single Phase Hybrid Inverter
lol no thanks
[dodosolar] 10kw inverter also available. please fill up the form for a complete quote.
[shaidas] Damn that is a good deal for a Sungrow setup
[shaidas] I do not remember asking mate.. so you are from China ?
[grizz] Do you install in metro WA and its the price same?
[dodosolar] Hi Yes we can do WA. please fill up the form for a complete quote.
[dodosolar] yes please fill up the form for a complete quote.
[nerdinary] I already have solar with a sungrow inverter, what if I just want the battery?
[dodosolar] Hi, please share current inverter photo and model number via euquiry form https://form.jotform.com/263182834894065
if the inverter is compatible with battery ,we can take off inverter cost
[Yamato] Any deal for battery for embedded network with solar already
[AliensStoleMyMoney] any option for sbr module installs?
i have 9.6kw stack already but looking to expand
located in SA
[1Kenobi] If I already have a Tesla powerwall2 , can I add this separately? Would they fight with each other?
[Tollery] The way you are telling everyone to fill in the form (third party form), comes across as a bit of a scam.
